rationale: The benchmark candidate requires structured delivery because it introduces product semantics and runtime behavior across multiple hosts and canonical owners. Compact Delivery is not evidenced, and Verified Change is ineligible because ownership is not singular and derived-path propagation is not deterministic.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Brownfield candidate evidence identifies 6 canonical owners, 8 source paths, and 8 derived paths.
Impacts include product semantics, runtime behavior, and cross-host behavior.
Deterministic validation is available, but deterministic propagation is false.
Verified Change requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist; both fail.
Compact Delivery requires a completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context; neither is supplied in the evid
